title: Positive measure of the disjointness event
statement: Fix a positive integer $n$, and consider the finite sample space of hard-distribution samples, each of which determines Alice's input set $X \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\}$ and Bob's input set $Y \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\}$. Under the ambient measure on this sample space, the disjoint event — the set of samples for which $X$ and $Y$ are disjoint — has nonzero measure.
replaced: The disjoint event has positive measure under the hard distribution.
